modal.title: Subscription: {{plan}}
modal.whatTitle: What are credits and when are they used?
modal.chargeStore: Every published product uses 1 credit (also every product from a CSV import). Donations are always free.
modal.chargeRestaurant: Every reservation uses 1 credit. Donations are always free.
modal.refundTitle: When do you get a credit back?
modal.refundStore: If you delete a product, or move all of it to donations, on the same day and nobody has reserved it, the credit comes back. A new day starts at 01:00 our time; after that the credit stays used.
modal.refundRestaurant: If you cancel a reservation yourself on the same day, the credit comes back (a new day starts at 01:00 our time). If the store rejects the reservation or the system cancels it, the credit always comes back. A missed pickup is not refunded.
modal.expiry: Credits are valid until the end of the calendar month and do not carry over.
modal.balance: You can always see your balance on the Credits page in the menu.
modal.forNext: The new plan starts in {{month}}; this month stays as it is.
modal.smallerPlanHint: The month has already started, so a smaller plan may be enough.
modal.payment: Payment happens outside the app for now: an administrator approves the request once it is paid.
modal.sent: Request sent. An administrator will review it soon.
